role_policy: Whole episodes fixed before collection. Keep all original outcomes; no favourable slicing, role reassignment, evaluation fitting or normalization.
sampling_reason: Longer continuous route coverage within existing30kmh/30s per-lease limits, to reach both turning directions and potential actual corner braking. Coverage must be measured rather than assumed.
camera_policy: Copy all4 immutable shared textures to owned CPU images, ack, then persist and publish at actual receipt. Original150ms motion guard and110ms consumer age remain unchanged.
ownership_scope: Engine-AI teacher leases only. CSP idle and actual stationary full brake required between records. Record native AI flag separately because its disagreement after AI disable is unresolved; this is not permission for fly-policy actuation or native ownership qualification.
braking_policy: Only actual driving phase applied controls may be labels; API cleanup stop is excluded. Do not claim learned braking if positive train/development braking is absent.
failure_policy: Stop on first failed recorder, nonzero child exit or unverified CSP/native stationary teardown. Preserve partial failed episode and all earlier episodes. No automatic retry or UI fallback.
